title: First New Orleans band, Ernest Johnson's, and Jack Carey hearing him
summary: Miller joined Ernest Johnson's band through an Army friend, and Jack Carey heard him there and hired him.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now what was the first band you played with here?
Ernest Johnson. You know Dave Johnson? Played the drum. He played, he was a, well you remember that Sunday you gave me two dollars on there by
Yeah. Well he was playing the bass drum that Sunday.

Yeah, Dave Bailey. Yeah, well that's Ernest Johnson's brother. See? They must be half brother. But anyhow, they were always there, we were out in front of town there on Chippy Ward in St. Thomas. That's where they lived then. And what made me go out there, it was a boy out in the army, what he did now, I forget his name, but his mother lived out there and he told me to come and I could stay with him. That's how we were good friends in the army see? So he brought me there and they really treated me nice. I lived good. Well that's how I joined that band. He went to Ernest Johnson and Barberman see? And I got in that band there. Well Jack Carey was on the Avatar one Sunday and he heard me play. He used to steal for guys like that you know, so he'd find out where I lived and come out there and talk to him and I'd like to come back, you know back of town anyhow. So I come on and join Jack Carey. And I played with Jack a long climb, man. There was one fella that I really wish would have did something like a record or some kind of something before he died. I liked him so much, that was Buddy Petit. Oh yeah. Ain't got nothing of him.
